items.title: US to deport 150 Afghan immigrants back to Kabul
items.description:
WASHINGTON: President Don­­ald Trump’s administration plans to deport more than 150 Afghan immigrants back to Afghanistan via Pakistan, US media reported, a move advocacy groups say could endanger their lives.
Trump last year issued travel bans for a number of countries, including Afghanistan, as part of a broad immigration crackdown, and sought to end deportation protections for Afghans, some of whom were granted special immigrant visas following the August 2021 takeover by the Taliban.

items.title: Pakistan’s Punjab records 4.2 times more crop-fire detections than Indian Punjab: report
items.description:
LAHORE: Crop-fire detections in Pakistan’s Punjab were 4.2 times higher than in Indian Punjab during the first 29 days of October, according to satellite data, as the province grapples with worsening smog.
According to an analysis published by environmental monitoring website HamariHawa, Nasa satellites detected 13,241 fire spots in Pakistan’s Punjab between Oct 1 and 29, compared with 3,158 in Indian Punjab — 4.2 times as many detections.
